name: rdl-theme
description: Two design-system skills. RDL Theme v3: build consistent, minimal apps in the RonDesignLab style (glass default, flat v1 option) with calibrated tokens, a measured layout system, component anatomy and an automated UI audit. Atlas v1: an accessibility-first system (WCAG 2.2 AA by construction) with a contrast-anchored palette proven by script, 19 atoms, 23 components with APG keyboard behaviour, accessibility guidelines and an automated a11y audit.
